input_text: Explain the 1. Abstract section of the Attention Is All You Need research paper.
target_text: The paper introduces the Transformer, a new neural network architecture designed mainly for sequence-to-sequence tasks such as machine translation. Unlike traditional models that depend on recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or convolutional neural networks (CNNs), the Transformer uses attention mechanisms alone. This removes the need for sequential computation, allowing the model to process many parts of a sequence in parallel. The paper shows that the Transformer achieves better translation quality while requiring significantly less training time.

target_text: Another important reason is the ability of self-attention to establish direct relationships between different elements. The original paper explains that self-attention connects different positions with a constant number of sequential operations, making long-range dependencies easier to learn compared with recurrent architectures. When this idea is transferred to tabular FIFA data, the different columns can interact with one another through attention, allowing the model to learn higher-level feature interactions.

input_text: Explain the 3. Model Architecture section of the Attention Is All You Need research paper.
target_text: The FIFA dataset is tabular rather than sequential text and contains various numerical and categorical player-related features. To apply the Transformer concept, each feature can be represented as a token or embedding instead of treating words as tokens. This allows the model to learn relationships between different player attributes.
